title: ALIVE again, ye band of Cherubim

lines.text: ALIVE again, ye band of Cherubim
Life once again ye band of Seraphim
Unto Jehovah loudest praises sing
Lo! He return to you ever.
Let not be sad for the Lord shall not lie
The promise He made with our fathers
Shall for sure come to pass
On this lovely day. God now return to you ever.
Never again shall you all be alone
Lo, the saviour return to you
Angels rejoice with you ever
See the heaven’s windows opened
With thine spiritual eyes
Salvation return to you ever.
Lo, the Lord God Omnipotent return
In the splendour of the heaven
He shall never forsake you
See the heaven’s windows opened
With thine spiritual eyes
Salvation return to you ever.
Hear the songs of Cherubim in heaven
See the dances of the Seraphim in heaven
Unto Jehovah loudest praises sing
Salvation return to you ever.
Alive again ye band of Seraphim
He return to you ever
Alive again ye band of Cherubim
He return to you ever.  Amin
